text:
Maya R: Quick sync — planning a staggered rollout for quant-profile v2 + engine kernel 1.12 to prod tomorrow 02:00 PST. Need a deploy owner, canary groups, and a rollback plan. Proposed: start 2% canary, 30m observation, then 25% / 50% / 100% ramps. Any blockers?

Jordan L: I can own the deploy. Infra: GPUs in us-west look free at that time. Can someone paste the smoke checklist so I know what to watch?

Priya S: I'll run perf + correctness smoke. Quick checklist: 1) sanity generation on canary sample set, 2) p95 latency goal <350ms, 3) no streaming errors (99.9% success), 4) KV cache hit-rate sanity. I'll post exact commands momentarily.

Noah K: I'll prepare rollback artifacts and dashboards. Rollback command prototype: `rctl deploy rollback --service=runtime --to=engine-1.11 --quant=profile-v1`. Health quick-check: `curl -sS https://metrics.internal/api/health | jq .`

Eve C: Request: start at 2% (not 5%) — last time 5% made noisy metric spikes. Also please pin model variant for canary (model=redwood-small:v3).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/engine kernel=1.12 + quant=profile-v2 at 2026-03-18 02:00:00 PST by @Jordan L. Canary groups configured: canary-a=2%, canary-b=25%. Ramp steps are manual.

Maya R: Sounds good. Jordan -> you're owner. Priya -> post smoke commands here. Noah -> make rollback script runnable from CI with secrets validated. Eve -> we'll pin canary model variant and start at 2%.

Priya S: Here are the smoke snippets to run during canary window:
```bash
# sanity generation over sample prompts
for p in samples/canary_prompts/*.json; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d "@$p" | jq -r '.status'
done

# latency test (wrk)
w rk -t4 -c100 -d60s -s scripts/gen.lua --latency https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream
```

Noah K: I'll add a `--force-rollback` flag and make the command available in ops/rollback.sh. Also will add a lightweight health probe that fails the canary if streaming error rate >0.5%. I'll pre-create the dashboard panels and update the runbook. Oncall rotation for the window: Priya -> Noah -> Jordan.

Jordan L: I'll start the deploy at 02:00, toggle canary-a (2%), wait 30m, then manual ramps (25% -> 50% -> 100%) over next 2 hours depending on metrics. I'll ping @eng-oncall 15m before start.

Maya R: If no objections by EOD, we proceed with this schedule. Also reminder: add a short post-deploy note in #eng-runtime with perf numbers and any anomalies. :thumbsup:

Priya S: :thumbsup:
